name: Simplified Citizenship -- Lithuanian Descent

qualifying_event.description: A person of Lithuanian descent (parents, grandparents, or great-grandparents were Lithuanian) who has never held Lithuanian citizenship may acquire it via a simplified procedure under Article 10, without residence, language, or exam requirements.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documented Lithuanian descent (ancestor's birth/citizenship records); declaration of never having held Lithuanian citizenship.

requirement_groups.name: Person of Lithuanian descent who has never held Lithuanian citizenship

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be of Lithuanian descent (parents, grandparents, or great-grandparents were Lithuanian) under Article 10 of the Law on Citizenship, and must not have previously held Lithuanian citizenship (that case falls under the restoration route instead).
No residence period, language exam, or Constitution exam is required under this route.

evidence_required.document: Proof of Lithuanian descent (ancestor's birth/citizenship records)
Declaration of never having held Lithuanian citizenship

sources.title: e-Seimas (Lithuania's official legislative database) -- Law on Citizenship, Article 10 (persons of Lithuanian descent)
